usage: 炒牛肉 is commonly used as a noun referring to a type of dish.
You can mention 炒牛肉 when ordering food or talking about meals.
It can be combined with adjectives to describe the dish's taste or style, like '好味嘅炒牛肉' (delicious stir-fried beef).
炒牛肉 can be used in both singular and plural contexts without change in form.
When asking questions or making requests, you can say '有冇炒牛肉？' (Do you have stir-fried beef?).
